info.title: ControlHub API
info.description: Versioned ControlHub REST API. Nanosecond timestamps are decimal strings.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start, unix epoch nanoseconds as a decimal string. Default: `to - 15m`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End (exclusive), unix epoch nanoseconds as a decimal string. Default: now.

get.description: WebSocket upgrade. Server messages: hello, batch, gap, heartbeat, error (JSON text frames).

parameters.name: resume
parameters.description: Resume cursor from a previous message (ingestion time, decimal nanoseconds).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the log body.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start, unix epoch nanoseconds as a decimal string. Default: `to - 15m`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End (exclusive), unix epoch nanoseconds as a decimal string. Default: now.

parameters.name: to

403.description: Origin not allowed or sign-up disabled

expires_at.description: Deadline for the decision (proposed) or for the executor to start (approved).

state.description: proposed, approved, rejected, cancelled, expired, running, succeeded, failed, verification_failed

allowed_here.description: Whether policy allows this type in this environment at all (demo-only check).

sampling.description: Sampling configured in SDKs is not reported to ControlHub yet.

truncated.description: The response hit a row limit; more data exists in the range.

unresolved_processing_errors.description: Records that failed processing and are waiting in the dead-letter table.

watermark_ns.description:
Data ingested before this time (nanoseconds) has been processed into storage.
`null` when the processor has not reported progress yet.

unsupported.description: Capabilities that are explicitly NOT available, so gaps are visible.

expires_in_days.description: API tokens: 1–90 days (default 30). Ingestion tokens: 1–365 days, or omitted for no expiry.

secret.description: Shown exactly once; only its hash is stored.

is_demo.description: Demo environments must always be labelled in the UI.

source_sequence.description: Decimal string (u64 does not fit a JS number).

body.description: Untrusted text. Render as plain text only.

PolicyDto.description: Schema of the stored policy decision (serialized `controlhub_actions::PolicyDecision`).

display_name.description: Shown in the UI; defaults to the part of the email before `@`.

project_name.description: Name of the first project; defaults to "My project".

grace_seconds.description: Seconds the old token keeps working (0–86400, default 0) so running senders can switch.

signals.description: Signals seen for this service in the range (`traces`, `logs`).

kind.description: OTLP SpanKind: 0 unspecified, 1 internal, 2 server, 3 client, 4 producer, 5 consumer.

target_entity_id.description: Resource / dependency entity this span calls (e.g. a database), when known.

TimelineItem.description:
One recorded item. IDs are the deduplication keys: applying the same item
twice has no additional effect.

TimelineResponse.description: Directly consumable by the engine's `applyBatch` (it reads `items`).

spans_truncated.description: Per-signal truncation: when true, the range holds more items than returned.

reasons.description: Evidence for inferred relationships. No numeric confidence is invented.

TopologyResponse.description: Superset of the engine's `TopologySnapshot`; the Worker passes it to WASM unchanged.

missing_parent_span_ids.description:
Parent span IDs referenced by spans in this trace but not recorded
(not instrumented, sampled out, dropped or still in flight).

api_token.description: Read-only API token (cha_…) bound to one environment; GET only.
